name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic Slider Keychain
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, offering a durable, lightweight, and eye-catching finish.
    - Features a 3-layer acrylic slider construction that creates a fun interactive design with a personalized inner sliding piece.
    - Includes acrylic layers in 2mm and 3mm thicknesses for a sturdy and dimensional structure.
    - Built with disc magnets to keep the slider pieces aligned securely during use.
    - Comes with a metal keyring for easy attachment to keys, bags, backpacks, or accessories.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 3.5 x 3.5 in ~ 8.89 x 8.89 cm.
    - Keyring length: 5 cm ~ 1.97 in.
    - Disc magnet size: 5mm x 3mm.
    - Supports up to 2 pairs of disc magnets.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1 – Piece 1 and Piece 2: 1-sided printing.
    - Layer 2:
             +) Piece 1 and Piece 2: No printing.
             +) Slider layer: 2-sided printing.
    - Layer 3 – Piece 1 and Piece 2: 1-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized keychain and an interactive slider keepsake.
    - Designed with a pull-up slider mechanism that reveals a customized inner lining or hidden character design.
    - Suitable for attaching to keys, backpacks, handbags, zipper pulls, or collectible displays.
    - The disc magnets help keep the layers aligned neatly when closed.
    - Perfect for everyday carrying, gift presentation, and personalized novelty collections.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for dads, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for military-themed gifts, family keepsakes, and custom novelty accessories.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving names, meaningful messages, and personalized artwork in a unique interactive format.
    - Great for key accessories, backpack charms, collectible keepsakes, and commemorative gifts.
    - Adds a fun, creative, and memorable touch to everyday essentials🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 3-Layer Acrylic Slider Keychain 

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
